cases.name: Natasha Yvette Jones Walker
cases.about:
She was the owner of Natasha's Credit Services, established 2014. Equally devoted to her community, she co-founded the Margaret Clinard Outreach Foundation, a nonprofit organization that focuses on indigent women and children of the Triad area.

Her obituary said, "Natasha worked at Apple, as a customer service representative for over six years. Later, she was inspired to become an entrepreneur and founded Natasha Credit Services. On this platform, she thrived and found her purpose.  By being a tax professional consultant, Natasha brought great joy and positivity to her community.  She truly enjoyed investing in her clients' future - Making the impossible, become possible.

Natasha attended her childhood church, St. Thomas Chapel, where she sung in the Children’s Choir as a child.  As an adult, she later joined the Usher Board and the Praise Dance Ministry. She truly loved attending church and giving glory to God for all he did in her life.

On November 7, 2021, Natasha married the love of her life, Jesse Omega Lee Walker. She was excited to celebrate her first full year of marriage with him this past November, 2022."

cases.name: Kathryn Garton Holmes
cases.about: Her daughter said she had a career as a police and fire communications center supervisor with 911 dispatch for the City of Coral Gables in Florida. During her time working there, she met her husband who was a police lieutenant for the Coral Gables Police Department. Her daughter said Holmes was looking forward to being the mother of the bride as her daughter is getting married in November.
cases.narrative: She died two days later. He allegedly shot her, striking her in the neck, as she was driving to meet him after the two set up a transaction through an online marketplace. She was driving her 2022 Volkswagen Toas SUV when the bullet struck her in the neck, leaving her paralyzed. She was then unable to take her foot off the accelerator, which caused her to drive into the ditch and crash.
